events.title: Sensor spike / noise burst
events.narrative: At 01 Sep 2026, 07:45:50 the system diagnosed a sensor spike / noise burst affecting Temperature. A single sample jumped far beyond anything this channel does naturally and then returned. That is the signature of an electrical impulse or a loose connection, not a real change in the weather. The clearest indicator: Temperature jumped 0.90 degC in one sampling interval - 4.5x the largest movement ever seen on this channel in healthy data. Temperature carries 1% of the statistical attribution, reading 24.11 degC (1.5 sigma above its normal level). Note that the joint-distance attribution is led by Relative humidity instead, because SHAP scores the level of each channel while this fault is defined by rate of change. 0 of 3 independent detectors flagged this sample. Inspect cabling, connectors and grounding at the sensor head.
why_detected: Temperature jumped 0.90 degC in one sampling interval - 4.5x the largest movement ever seen on this channel in healthy data.

recommendation.qc_note: Discard this sample; interpolate from neighbours.
field_actions: Inspect sensor cabling, connectors and grounding at the mast.

diagnosis.title: Sensor spike / noise burst on Barometric pressure

explanation.narrative: At 01 Sep 2026, 08:54:55 the system diagnosed a sensor spike / noise burst affecting Barometric pressure. A single sample jumped far beyond anything this channel does naturally and then returned. That is the signature of an electrical impulse or a loose connection, not a real change in the weather. The clearest indicator: Barometric pressure jumped 1.02 hPa in one sampling interval - 5.1x the largest movement ever seen on this channel in healthy data. Barometric pressure carries 7% of the statistical attribution, reading 970.65 hPa (1.5 sigma below its normal level). Note that the joint-distance attribution is led by Relative humidity instead, because SHAP scores the level of each channel while this fault is defined by rate of change. 2 of 3 independent detectors flagged this sample.
